name: xAI Realtime Voice (Discord)
description: Registers Grok Voice Agent (grok-voice-latest) as a RealtimeVoice provider for Discord agent-proxy, with local Whisper wake-gating, mic presence management, and a working-on-it audio cue. Requires runtime patches on stock OpenClaw 2026.7.x for the full wake-gated experience — see the README.
